text.description_html:
Fusion TR-T7, American Relic Series Blue Ridge Towel Ring

The Blue Ridge Hand Towel Ring is easy to install and comes packaged with all the necessary installation hardware. The wall mount is 2-2/4 inches wide and 4-1/4 inches tall. As part of Fusion's American Relic Collection, this towel ring exudes a traditional style perfect for restoration projects on historic homes.

Also Available Matching: Fusion TB-T7 Blue Ridge Towel Bar, Fusion PH-T7 Blue Ridge Toilet Paper Holder, and Fusion RH-T7 Blue Ridge Robe Hook

Features and Specifications of the Fusion Blue Ridge Trim Towel Ring:

  • Mount Width: 2-3/4"
  • Mount Length: 4-1/4"
  • Reversible to hang in either direction.
  • Comes packaged with mounting hardware.

Sold Individually
